briefdescription.para: Finds the atmospheric density at a given date and state.

parameterdescription.para: The date at which to find the atmospheric density.
The Cartesian state vector at which to find the atmospheric density.

simplesect.para: Density The atmospheric density at the specified date and state.

Assume that most bodies have no significant atmosphere. Assume that the atmosphere of the gas giants is defined by their radii, e.g. outside of their equitorial radius, they have no noticible atmosphere and inside that radius, the object will crash.
